answer: Sponsored admission with decaying reputation blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer stands on a narrow ledge: a sponsor must stake a 600 POA bond. It starts opal-grade, and reputation decays 10% each epoch without honest work; idle shells slide off and vanish. Minting 100 fakes needs 100 sponsors and 60,000 POA locked; a cheating protege costs its sponsor the bond. Honest agents pay one bond once, rise to onyx-grade standing, and earn without dilution.
